name: XO Cash
oneLiner: XO is MoonPay's Solana dollar token, issued through M0 infrastructure and backed by segregated U.S. dollars and other high-quality liquid assets.
collateral: Fully reserved 1:1 by U.S. dollars and other high-quality liquid USD-denominated assets held in segregated accounts for stablecoin holders; MoonPay's terms allow depository institutions, qualified custodians, and secure virtual-currency wallets but do not publish XO's current asset allocation
pegMechanism: 1:1 fiat-backed mint and redemption operated by MoonPay using M0 infrastructure on Solana; consumer access is provided through the Exodus self-custodial wallet and Exodus Pay app, with on/off ramps via MoonPay's payment rails; the Solana SPL Token-2022 mint includes pausable, permanent-delegate, and transfer-hook controls held by MoonPay

jurisdiction.regulator: FinCEN / NYDFS / state money transmitter regulators
jurisdiction.license: MoonPay Money Transmitter Licenses (49 states), New York BitLicense, New York Trust Charter
